text:
maya: Heads-up — deploy window tonight 21:00 UTC. Target services: runtime v3.4.2, api v2.1.0, router v1.9, console minor. Runtime must land and warm KV before router traffic shift. pin + canary plan below.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy created: id=deploy-22345, canary=5%, canary-window=15m, rollback-trigger=error_rate>2% (auto). Initiator: maya.

liam: Quick Q — runtime KV eviction change in v3.4.2 could surface 429s on heavy seqs. If we see cache thrash, do we pin router to previous?

ravi: Console note — UI flag "show-runtime-version" depends on router headers. I'll keep the flag off until router stable. I'll flip it post-verify.

sara: Suggest rollout order: api -> runtime -> router -> console. Runtime needs prewarm + LV cap before router switch. Also recommend staged weight: 5% -> 25% -> 75% -> 100% with 10m holds.

maya: Confirming order. Adding explicit pin steps and HA commands: 
```
# pin runtime globally
./deploy pin --service runtime --version v3.4.2 --regions all --reason "KV prewarm + kernel opt"
# start runtime canary
./deploy start --id deploy-22345 --service runtime --canary 5 --window 15m
# after runtime stable: start router canary
./deploy start --id deploy-22345 --service router --canary 5 --window 10m
```

orchestration-bot: Dependency scan result: router v1.9 <-> api v2.1.0 detected schema compatibility change: field "request_id" moved nullable->non-nullable. Recommend compatibility shim or api flag.

liam: We have fallback in runtime that accepts both shapes, but api must not start enforcing mandatory request_id until router is at 100%. Propose runtime shim + api feature flag `request_id_mandatory=false` for 6h. Also tag deploy with rollback label.

maya: Adding deployment metadata: `rollback: "auto-on-sla-hit"`, contingency: if 4xx rate increases >1.5x or p95 latency +30% vs baseline in canary window, trigger full rollback. @oncall-bot please ensure alerting thresholds are live.

oncall-bot: Alerting updated for deploy-22345: watch services/runtime errors, api 4xx rate, router p50/p95 latency. Paging policy unchanged. Escalation on sustained error_rate>2% for 5m.

sara: Infra will pre-warm KV caches and hold warmers 20m before canary start. I'll post ETA in 15m.

liam: Got it. I'll monitor canary dashboards: https://console.redwood.ai/dash/deploy-22345/metrics and be ready to flip rollback. :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks team — once prewarm done I'll kick final pin and start. Will post status updates in this thread.
